title: Progress in the Mechanism of Heat Shock Proteins in Gastric Cancer: From Biomarkers to Therapeutic Targets.
snippet: Gastric cancer remains a major challenge in public health, with low early diagnosis rates and poor prognosis for advanced patients. Heat shock proteins (HSPs) are highly conserved molecular chaperones that maintain proteostasis and promote cell survival under stress.
